props.classMechanic_text:
MAGISEEDS – FLORALIST CLASS MECHANIC

WHAT IS A MAGISEED?

Floralist fight by planting a magiseed that grows in a personal garden—an abstract space that can look like a pot on your back, a glowing bud on your blade, or roots under your feet. Your garden can hold only one magiseed at a time, and any magiseed in your garden is automatically removed when the scene ends.

CHLOROMANCY (PLANTING)

  • Each time you acquire Chloromancy, you discover a new magiseed type from the list below.
  • During a conflict, if your garden is empty, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to plant a magiseed you’ve discovered.

THE GROWTH CLOCK

  • Your Growth Clock has 4 sections and exists only during conflict scenes. It begins each scene empty.
  • End of your turn: if a magiseed is in your garden, fill 1 section of the Growth Clock, then resolve that magiseed’s “end of your turn” effect (if any).
  • When you fill the fourth section, remove the magiseed from your garden, then erase all sections of the Growth Clock.
  • Sections may not be filled or erased in any other way except by effects that explicitly modify Growth Clocks (e.g., specific Floralist skills like Brambleheart/Green Thumb).

USING MAGISEEDS

  • Magiseeds can grant passive benefits or effects that trigger at the end of your turn.
  • Their power depends on how many sections are currently filled in your Growth Clock. Apply only the effect that matches the exact number of filled sections—never above or below.
  • Effects end immediately if the magiseed leaves your garden.

Power Scaling: If a magiseed deals damage, it deals +5 extra damage if you are level 30+.
If a magiseed causes Hit Point and/or Mind Point loss or recovery, increase that value by +10 if you are level 30+.

TURN FLOW

  1. Plant (action, 20 MP) if your garden is empty.
  2. End of Turn: fill 1 Growth section → resolve the magiseed effect matching the current total.

  • Effects stop immediately if the magiseed is removed.
  • Scene ends = garden clears.
  • Some effects reference allies you can see or enemies you can see—line of sight matters.

NBf9gb8FdYzx6N28.name: Greater Chloromancy
NBf9gb8FdYzx6N28.skill_description:
Once per turn when a magiseed leaves your garden, if that magiseed has one or more “at the end of your turn” effects, you may spend 20 Mind Points. If you do, reproduce one of those effects (you may also choose an effect that doesn’t match the current sections of your Growth Clock).

Additionally, if you have acquired the 【📜Verdant Sway】 Skill, your Rituals can now also influence and control soldier-Rank creatures belonging to the plant Species (but you are still unable to create them).

biJh9ryRECTlLtcY.name: Green Thumb
biJh9ryRECTlLtcY.skill_description:
When you fill 1 or more sections of your Growth Clock, you may choose one option:

  • you fill 1 additional section of your Growth Clock;
  • or you fill 1 fewer section of your Growth Clock (to a minimum of 0 sections filled).

If you do, you cannot use this effect again until after your Growth Clock has become completely empty.

Additionally, damage dealt by your magiseeds ignores Resistances.

props.class_lore:
Spiritual energy flows strongly within plants, thanks to their direct connection to our earth. Growing from this encounter are magiseeds, gifted with the unique ability to thrive on spiritual energy and blossom into a majestic yet ephemeral triumph of magic.

Floralists can identify and cultivate these strange seeds, which grant a large variety of benefits and can be combined with all sorts of disciplines, martial and magical.

2ijStwemZ8ZJW2F5.name: Verdant Sway
2ijStwemZ8ZJW2F5.skill_description:
You gain the ability to perform Rituals of the Ritualism discipline

Additionally, you may use Ritualism to create, animate, and/or control vegetation, pollen, spores, and toxins (but you cannot create nor control plant-Species NPCs this way).

P2JQbBjtZo2tFxcZ.name: Graft
P2JQbBjtZo2tFxcZ.skill_description: As long as there is a magiseed in your garden and 1 or more sections of your Growth Clock are filled, you may use an action to remove that magiseed from your garden: if you do, plant a different magiseed among those you have discovered (keep the current filled sections of your Growth Clock unchanged).

SGhc6KJN47rVZJri.name: Tree of Life
SGhc6KJN47rVZJri.skill_description: When you remove a magiseed from your garden, you may choose one creature you can see: if that creature is in Crisis, they recover [5 + (SL × 5)] Hit Points.

aHHxOuvMdRXtzGM7.name: Chrolomancy
aHHxOuvMdRXtzGM7.skill_description:
Each time you acquire this Skill, you discover a new type of magiseed from the list found in the next pages.

During a conflict, if there are no magiseeds in your garden, you may use an action and spend 20 Mind Points to plant a magiseed of a type you have discovered. The rules for the garden and for magiseed growth can be found on the Unique Mechanic page.

hfeQMnoo7JuJ7tT4.name: Battle Gardening
hfeQMnoo7JuJ7tT4.skill_description:
After you plant a magiseed through the Chloromancy Skill (not when using 【📜Graft】), you may choose one option:

  • Perform a free 【⚔️Attack】 with an equipped weapon
  • Perform the 【📕Spell】 action for free, casting a spell with a total Mind Point cost equal to or lower than [5 + (SL × 5)] (you must still pay its MP cost).

Treat the High Roll (HR) of your Accuracy Check or Magic Check as being equal to 0 when determining damage dealt by this attack or spell.
